description: Context menu triggered on a specific area or item.

howToUse: Use it for the actions of an item that people open with a right-click or a long press: a file, a card, a table row.
Pass the actions in `entries`, handle them in `onSelect`, and name the area with `label`.
Offer the same actions in a visible place too, such as a Menu on the item: many people never right-click.

keyboard.action: Opens the menu in the area in focus.
Same as Menu: move, run, close.

examples.label: Interactive
